summary: The family watches the count in the home sitting room with a buffet and two televisions while an adviser works elsewhere.
realLife: On election night 2004 the president watched in his living quarters with his wife, daughters, parents and siblings. They ate from a buffet and watched split-screen returns on two televisions, while an adviser tracked numbers on a computer in another room.
gates: An election result is pending for a seat the household cares about.
inGame: election-day scene, household members and kin ties can carry it.

turns.what: The count drags and the family drifts to bed.
The candidate sits alone with the adviser.
